blocks.heading: Objectives of marketing
blocks.text: Marketing objectives can include increasing sales, increasing market share, attracting new customers, retaining existing customers, developing awareness and supporting a successful new-product launch. They should fit wider business aims and available resources. State a result, not just an activity: running an advertisement is an action, whereas increasing awareness among a defined target group is an objective. A measurable target and time period make review possible. More sales are not automatically more profit if the cost of achieving them exceeds the added return.

blocks.heading: Putting the idea to work
blocks.text: Eha Goods wants repeat purchases from existing local customers over the next three months. Retention is the objective; a reminder message or improved service is a possible action. Management should review repeat purchases and cost rather than regard sending the reminder as proof of success.
